book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Nogoba Gaubanana Hari Idaidaḡa
Iesuꞌa bare reiro, “Eꞌe madaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌetaꞌaꞌe nogoba gaubanana teigiꞌuma. Ze ihureze madu hahu ohoze iziga hidoga veize onamiro.
Zeḡe boꞌaḡano fuꞌoꞌe kauriḡa ebu fuꞌoꞌe huhuzaḡa.
Nogoba kauriḡa fuꞌoꞌe ihureze odohiro, rehano ihure vuḡaꞌe mene meiro.
U nogoba huhuzaḡa fuꞌoꞌe ihurezeta ihure vuḡa biozeo abe odohiro.
Ebu hahu ohoze iziganiꞌa mene ḡarihe arirotene, ze ubumaze anozadu bazubazu uhiro.
Ohere nemanema ze ago ꞌahoga igiro, 'Hahu ohoze iziganiꞌa feureha! Buanadu ani hidoꞌi!'
ꞌOugirotene nogoba niduꞌa evatadu ihureze ruhibiro.
Ebu nogoba kauriḡa fuꞌoꞌa nogoba huhuzaḡa fuꞌo umiziro, 'Za ihure vuḡa nuḡo eme rifoꞌi, mazaḡa eme ihureꞌe vidauꞌohe.'
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeziro, 'Mene, 'ahiꞌe za zu emeḡe niduꞌa veize mene idaḡa. Ihure vuḡa seroneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa vaḡe onamadu zae veize nu hoitoꞌi.'
Rehano ze ihureze vuḡa hoitoga uꞌa onamiroteꞌea, hahu ohoze iziganiꞌa feuriro. Ebu ihureze zu ihureze vuḡa ruhibiroteꞌe nogobaḡa fuꞌoꞌa ani teite mui habaꞌa diuḡiro ebu ibihetaḡaꞌe hararo.
Vesuꞌu nogoba kauriḡa fuꞌoꞌa feuradu reiro, 'Vaze boro! Vaze boro! Ibiheta vavaofoꞌi!'
Rehano aneꞌa naenaeziro, 'Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, e za aḡuꞌa.'
Eꞌanoꞌo tohutohe radoꞌi, mazaḡa eḡeꞌa bare ariteꞌe madaḡaꞌe zaꞌe aḡuꞌa.”
Tuḡure Azaḡa Uḡidu Hari Idaidaḡa
“Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌetaꞌaꞌe haba faḡa ragaveꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoga heuḡa. Aniꞌa iḡunirotene, tuḡureḡa azaḡa ane ḡau niduꞌa zenadu faine taufoꞌi rae reiro.
Zeḡe tibatiba inaraze idunaḡano, ꞌahogaꞌe hadi silivaḡa fuse
fuꞌo, ꞌahogaꞌe fuse aheu ebu ꞌahogaꞌe fuse tiba ziniro. Ebu aniꞌa haba faḡa ragaviro.
Hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa fuꞌo meiroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe zogone onamadu eꞌe hadiḡa hina gauiro, ebu hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa fuꞌo ragate hidiro.
Hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa aheu meiroteꞌe vazeḡa zuni ꞌouge haḡadu hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa aheu ragate hidiro.
Rehano hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa tiba meiroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe onamadu rahao idu huꞌiro, ebu zuhiꞌaḡa hadi eꞌea gure ꞌuꞌuru tiro.
Mada faḡa ḡarugano tuḡure azaḡa zuhiꞌazeꞌa bariro. Ebu zeḡeꞌa ane hadi hina nougenouge gauiroteꞌe ederifine huziro.

Hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa fuꞌo meiroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa hadi fuseḡa fuꞌo bare ragate hidirotaꞌaꞌe odohe aradu niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ḡaꞌa hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa fuꞌo iniro. Ḡianoꞌi, eḡeꞌa hadi eꞌe hina gauadu hadi fuseḡa fuꞌo ragate hidiro.'

Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa niro, 'Manoḡa tauḡi, ḡaꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa manoḡa zu zamaḡo niduꞌa hina gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa! Ḡaeꞌa gau komeꞌa zamaḡo niduꞌa hina faine odohe gauiro ꞌahine, eḡeꞌa ḡau ḡehaḡa taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡano ohoꞌiꞌuma. Aroꞌi, zuhiꞌaḡo teite matuꞌihi.'
Ebu hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa aheu meiroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa aradu niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ḡaꞌa hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa aheu iniro. Ḡianoꞌi, eḡeꞌa hadi eꞌe hina gauadu hadi fuseḡa aheu ragate hidiro.'

Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa niro, 'Manoḡa tauḡi, ḡaꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa manoḡa zu zamaḡo niduꞌa hina gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa! Ḡaeꞌa gau komeꞌa zamaḡo niduꞌa hina faine odohe gauiro ꞌahine, eḡeꞌa ḡau ḡehaḡa taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡano ohoꞌiꞌuma. Aroꞌi, zuhiꞌaḡo teite matuꞌihi.'

Rehano hadi siliva fuseḡa tiba meiroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa aradu niro, 'Zuhiꞌa, ḡaꞌe vaze riḡa. E ederiro, vazeꞌa ḡoraroteꞌe ḡauḡa ḡaeꞌa hiriveꞌohe, ebu vazeꞌa feune ḡoraroteꞌe ezoneḡa ḡaeꞌa hirive nuꞌoneꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo e ḡa rihoꞌadu rahao gure tiro. Ḡae hadi ꞌahi bare moꞌi.'
Zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa naenaeniro, 'Ḡaꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa sauꞌa ebu tubuḡa! Ḡaꞌe vazeꞌa ḡoraroteꞌe ḡauḡa eḡeꞌa hiriveꞌohe ebu vazeꞌa feune ḡoraroteꞌe ezoneḡa eḡeꞌa hirive nuꞌoneꞌohe rae ederirohe?
ꞌOugirotene, ḡa nougadu hadi tiꞌeteꞌe neḡano eḡe hadi mene tiro? ꞌOugifone, e bare aradu eḡe hadi ufeta ragate meifo.'
Hena zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa tuḡure azaḡa ziro, 'Hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa tiba ani mazaonoꞌo bare madu hadi silivaḡa fuseḡa gaubanana meiroteꞌe vazeḡa hanoꞌi.
Iniuꞌa nagini hidiroteꞌe faine odohe gauine, ani bare ufeta borofe hidiꞌuma. Rehano iniuꞌa nagini hidiroteꞌe mene faine odohe gauine, ani mazao nagini komeꞌa zuni meiniꞌuma.
Ebu tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌadiꞌe eḡe veize mene faine gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahine, enona uzabo zamaḡano mae feunoꞌi. Eꞌea ani niaꞌuma ebu ḡonoga atitiꞌuma.'”
Badiꞌa Kota Ḡonaga
Ebu Iesuꞌa reiro, “Vaze Ubuganiꞌa niḡa mae ḡihineꞌenaꞌa, tuḡure viga niduꞌa teite arine, aniꞌe ane ehoro habaꞌa, kini ehoro habaꞌa ḡihiꞌaḡano ehoriꞌuma.
Aniꞌa habaꞌahabaꞌa azaḡa niduꞌa ane zamao nuꞌozadu mamoe taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa mamoeꞌe gouti mazaonoꞌo rovozeꞌeteꞌe teige, ze rovoziꞌuma.
Ebu iniu vaze mamoe heuḡaꞌe ane edaꞌe moneo zu iniu vaze gouti heuḡaꞌe ane kauri moneo ohoziꞌuma.

Ebu hena kinizeꞌa edaꞌe mone azaḡa ziꞌuma, 'Zaꞌe eḡe Mama mazaonoꞌo manohuga meiroteꞌe azaḡa. Aroꞌi ebu eḡeꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe habaꞌano radoꞌi. Eꞌe habaꞌaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ḡau niduꞌa haḡairoteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo ruhiniro.
Mazaḡa e vinihirotene zaeꞌa ogomu inido, zu e irinehe moꞌohirotene zaeꞌa vu inido, ebu e iꞌudo vazeḡa reirotene zaeꞌa zae neo huhe zouhido.
Dabuahe oꞌoꞌa reirotene zaeꞌa dabua inido, zu e ugihirotene zaeꞌa eḡe taufido, ebu e ḡuꞌa neḡano radirotene zaeꞌa ḡiahi ariro.'
Ebu duduḡa azaḡaniꞌa naenaeniꞌuma, 'Zuhiꞌa Boro, eme naniꞌa ḡaꞌe viniꞌiroteꞌe horo'adu ogomu ḡanido? Naniꞌa eme ḡaꞌe irigo moꞌoꞌiroteꞌe horoꞌadu vu ḡanido?
Naniꞌa eme ḡaꞌe iꞌudo vazeḡa reiroteꞌe horoꞌadu neo huḡade zouꞌido? Naniꞌa eme dabuaḡo ꞌoꞌoꞌa reiroteꞌe horoꞌadu dabua ḡanido?
Naniꞌa eme ḡa ugiꞌiroteꞌe ga ḡuꞌa neḡano radiroteꞌe horoꞌadu ḡa ḡiaꞌi amido?'
Ebu kinizeꞌa naenaeziꞌuma, 'Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zaeꞌa eḡe nego nabudi ꞌahi boꞌaḡano ḡonaga vazeḡa ꞌahoga veize ꞌouge haḡairotaꞌaꞌe eḡe veize haḡairoteꞌe heuḡa.'

Ebu kinizeꞌa vaetadu kauri mone azaḡa ziꞌuma, 'Zaꞌe aduga tuḡutuḡu meiroteꞌe azaḡa, eḡe mazaonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi, ebu Satani zu ane tuḡure viga niduꞌa veize ruhiniroteꞌe ire rogaḡa radiu tuḡutuḡu zamaḡa diuḡoꞌi.
Mazaḡa e vinihirotene zaeꞌa ogomu mene inido, zu e irinehe moꞌohirotene zaeꞌa vu mene inido.
E iꞌudo vazeḡa reirotene zaeꞌa neo mene huhe zouhido, zu e dabuahe oꞌoꞌa reirotene zaeꞌa dabua mene inido, ebu e ugihirotene zu ḡuꞌa neḡano radirotene, zaeꞌa e mene taufido.'

ꞌOugadu zeꞌa naenaeniꞌuma, 'Zuhiꞌa Boro, naniꞌa eme ḡaꞌe viniꞌiroteꞌe ga irigo moꞌoꞌiroteꞌe ga iꞌudo vazeḡa reiroteꞌe ga dabuaḡo ꞌoꞌoꞌa reiroteꞌe ga ugiꞌiroteꞌe ga ḡuꞌa neḡano radiroteꞌe horoꞌadu mene danaꞌido?'
Ebu kinizeꞌa naenaeziꞌuma, 'Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, ꞌahi azaḡa boꞌaḡano ḡonaga vazeḡa ꞌahoga veize mene haḡairotaꞌaꞌe eḡe veize mene haḡairoteꞌe heuḡa.'
Eꞌanoꞌo kauri mone azaḡaꞌe aduga tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma, u duduḡa azaḡaꞌe ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma.”
